description: This file is a Python script demonstrating the implementation of Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) for few-shot Omniglot classification using PyTorch and higher. It includes data loading, model definition, training, testing, and plotting functions.

classes.name: Flatten
classes.description: A simple neural network module that flattens its input tensor into 2D (batch size, features).

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to set up data, model, optimizer, and run training and testing loops.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Performs training over a batch of tasks using higher for inner-loop adaptation.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Evaluates the model on test tasks without fine-tuning, using higher for inner-loop adaptation.

methods.name: plot
methods.description: Plots training and testing accuracy over epochs.
